note: Which lever SHAPES can be ticked in Unity. Run by BOTH sides: the kit (Levers.NotTickableReason and Levers.NotLiteralEnough, which must agree) and the website's lint (placeholderFirst, or unsendableText for a character the window cannot show as it runs, and a whole document through lintShotsDocument). 'refused' true = the kit will not tick it and ignores it if it is in levers.json by hand; the site refuses to send it. Added 2026-09-21 (the fourth audit of slice A2'): there was no shared fixture for lever shapes before, only for lever LISTS (shots-grammar, adapter-levers). A `hide-overlay …` or `camera-spec …` command (added 2026-09-22, the seventh audit) is the one exception to 'ignores it': the kit will not tick one either, and one in levers.json by hand approves only its own exact text. The file is DATA: a case one side disagrees with is a finding to take to both sides, never a line to edit here.
